title: DeepSeek Raises $23B to Expand AI Compute Capacity
summary:
The AI developer has secured a total of RMB 156.5B from investors across its most recent funding cycles to grow its technical infrastructure. The fundraising, which occurred over four months, equals roughly $23B and includes a 27% share of capital from Chinese state owned entities.

To manage surging prices for Nvidia Blackwell chips on the black market, the firm doubled the size of its most recent investment round. The details regarding the investor composition and the total amount raised were disclosed following an analysis of the company's cap table by The Information.
